en-US.description: Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.
en-US.longDescription: Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
en-US.name: Lexora Buddy
en-US.releaseNotes:
This release continues to refine the Agent experience. Mention companions by clicking their avatars or names, and view local workspace images directly in conversations. Quoted messages retain the original companion’s name, while sidebar indicators distinguish active execution, pending answers, and approval requests.
We’ve addressed long-conversation scrolling, reading-position restoration, duplicate queued messages, slow browser navigation, and compatibility with certain image-generation services. The independently updated Local Models plugin also improves local imports with manual capability selection, optimized GGUF reading, and Qwen3.5 model-structure validation.

zh-CN.description: 具备插件、内置浏览器、工作区文件与本地模型支持的桌面 AI Agent。
zh-CN.longDescription: Lexora 是在真实桌面实践中自我演化的个人 AI Agent。它不局限于代码助手的角色，也能陪你整理资料、打磨作品、安排日常。你说出目标，它持续推进，让文字成为工作、创作与生活的起点。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
这个版本，我们继续 打磨 Agent 使用体验：点击对话中的头像或名字即可点名伙伴，在回复中直接查看任务工作区的本地图片；引用消息保留原伙伴名称，侧栏也能区分正在执行、等待回答和等待确认，让任务状态与对话来源更清楚。
同时，我们修复了长对话滚动、阅读位置恢复、队列消息重复展示，以及浏览器慢加载和部分图像服务兼容性问题。独立更新的 “本地模型”插件 也进一步改善了本地导入体验，支持手动选择模型用途，并优化 GGUF 文件读取与 Qwen3.5 模型结构校验。
